blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Two times the bracket five plus three times the quantity ten minus five, squared, divided by five, close bracket, minus six.
Work from the inside out. In the innermost group, ten minus five is five.
Inside the brackets, the exponent comes next. Five squared is twenty-five.
Then multiplication and division, left to right. Three times twenty-five is seventy-five.
Seventy-five divided by five is fifteen.
Now finish the brackets. Five plus fifteen is twenty.
The brackets are done, so multiply. Two times twenty is forty.
Finally, forty minus six is thirty-four.
Watch out for these traps. If you square only the five, you get negative fourteen. If you add five and three before multiplying, you get seventy-four.
